verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Group net turnover decreased 4% to EUR 25.99 million with a loss of EUR 643,000 (compared to EUR 2.37 million loss prior year). candidate_sentences.text: For the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, A/S SAF Tehnika reported consolidated net revenue of EUR 25.99 million, representing a 4 percent decrease from EUR 27.09 million in the prior year.
The parent company alone recorded EUR 21.92 million, down 6 percent.
Despite the revenue decline, the group posted a net loss of EUR 643 thousand, a substantial improvement compared to the EUR 2.37 million loss in the previous year.
On a standalone basis, the parent company recorded a net loss of EUR 552 thousand versus EUR 1.34 million previously.

verified_key_information_units.information: Regional revenue changes: Americas region turnover decreased 14% to EUR 14.17 million (55% of group turnover), Europe region turnover increased 17% to EUR 10.0 million, Asia/TMiddle East/Africa region turnover decreased 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

candidate_sentences.text: Geographically, the Americas segment accounted for 55 percent of total revenue, generating EUR 14.17 million, a 14 percent decline attributed to client caution following investment reassessments and tariff policy announcements.
European operations, including Latvia, grew by 17 percent to EUR 10.0 million, while the Asia, Middle East, and Africa region saw a slight 5 percent decrease to EUR 1.8 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impact of geopolitical factors: Ongoing US-China trade tensions affect global electronics markets but currently have no significant negative impact on group sales; import duties remain unchanged for microwave equipment imported to the US from the EU, while Aranet products face a 15% duty; Canada branch established to mitigate supply chain and customs cost risks.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (ģeopolitiskie riski un muitas nodokļi)

candidate_sentences.text: Global geopolitical dynamics, including ongoing trade tensions between the United States and China, have not materially disrupted sales volumes.
Import duties on microwave equipment into the US remain unchanged, though the Aranet product line faces a 15 percent tariff.
To mitigate supply chain and customs risks, the group established a Canadian subsidiary during the reporting period.

verified_key_information_units.information: Product development and strategic focus: Continued investment in new product development (micro-wave data transmission, IoT solutions like Aranet), initiation of faster-to-implement product development initiatives, and market research to identify problem areas for product modifications and next-generation technology prototypes.
